o.text: Borrowed from Russian помидо́р (pomidór), from Italian pomi d'oro.

From Proto-Turkic *ēd (“thing, goods”) + -lə, a denominal suffix. Cognate with Turkish eylemek (“to do, make”). Unrelated to Turkish elemek (“to sift”) (< elge < el 'hand') and to the synonymous Azerbaijani etmək (“to do”) (< Proto-Turkic *ēt-).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آیرلمق (ayrılmaq). Equivalent to ayır- + -ıl.
From reciprocal form of Proto-Turkic *bar- (“to walk, go; to come, reach”), whence also Azerbaijani varmaq (“to go”).
